text:
carla_sales: Heads up - corporate card declined at the hotel check-in so I charged the $312.40 room + tax on my personal card. Can I get reimbursed? Also the hotel only gave an itemized folio in person, I photographed it: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/1825007777-hotel-folio.jpg

devin_finance: Thanks Carla. Can you confirm last4 of the personal card and attach the folio? For stays > $300 need manager approval and a short justification. Policy: https://intranet.redwood.example/policies/travel#lodging

carla_sales: Last4 6678. Hotel folio link above shows nightly rate $280.00 + tax/fees = $312.40. Reason: corporate card declined at terminal; tried to swipe twice. Front desk said their POS couldn't process our Amex corporate BIN.

marta_travel: Travel ops note: we've seen this POS issue at the Hotel Meridian location before. We can flag the vendor for corp-card onboarding but not retroactively.

ian_mgr: Confirming need to attend on-site client session and the corp card swiped failed. Approving reimbursement to personal card. :white_check_mark:

devin_finance: Ok manager approved. Carla please submit in Ramp as Expense type=Lodging, attach the folio photo, set reimbursement to bank ACH and provide last4 and "ACH" in the comments. We'll code to GL 6210.

carla_sales: Submitted RMP-23399 with tags project-ember and client-nomad. I included the note about POS failure and last4 6678.

ramp-bot: Expense RMP-23399 created and routed to Finance. ETA: next payroll cycle.

payments-bot: Expense RMP-23399 validated. Scheduled for ACH on next payout date. If you need expedited payment reply with "urgent" plus last4 and we'll process off-cycle.

devin_finance: All set. We'll queue the ACH. Closing thread. :thumbsup:
